package.description: Secure and minimal PDF viewer ideal for controlled environments like exams.

en-US.description: Secure and minimal PDF viewer ideal for controlled environments like exams.
en-US.longDescription:
Safe PDF Viewer is a secure, minimal PDF viewing application designed for controlled environments such as exams with the Safe Exam Browser, where distraction-free and safe document display is crucial.

Features:
- Secure PDF Display
- Minimalistic Interface
- Automated File Overview
- Exam Integration
- Lightweight, secure design tailored for controlled usage.

Ideal for integration with the Safe Exam Browser.
en-US.name: Safe PDF Viewer
